'''Frostluna''' is a [[Water]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Frostique]] at 6 silver moons after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Draped in a silvery blue fur that mirrors moonlight, Frostluna releases icy breaths under moonlit nights. Legend says the air freezes up in Frostluna's presence."

Frostluna is a rainbow rarity Tatari. Like all Tier 4 evolutions, it requires B Rating to acquire, therefore its feeding level cannot be below B rating for each stat. 

==Appearance==
A chubby cat with a white body and minimal blue spots on its back and tail. Its fluffy tail has solid ice branching out of it in a way that resembles a crescent moon, which it can use to "skate" around. Three Icicle like whiskers protrude from both cheeks, and its face as a deep blue marking resembling a mask. It has icy blue eyes with dark blue pupils the same color as its mask. Its ears and tips of its paws are a similar shade of deep blue as well.

Frostluna's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces blue with gold.

==Strategy==
[[File:Frostluna Attack Range.png|x200px|left|thumb|Frostluna's attack range]]
One of the strongest Water DPS, Frostluna is strong enough to carry a lane alone, as long as it has at least one other Tatari with it too provide support, like a [[Bubbit]]/evo, or [[Waddledo]]/evo. Due to its attack being able to Split, sometimes placing it in a lane next to one that is struggling is enough to help it get by. 
{{clear|left}}
